name: Bramble wall
notes: A wall of thorny bramble across the Jungle's path, right past the Meadow's south opening. Solid: nobody gets past. A FIRE move that touches it (Ember's flame on the tile in front is the easy one; Fire Spin and Flamethrower work too) burns it: it flares and crackles away for good (gate_2 = 1, saved). Any other move only makes a dull thud. The one in the Bramble Thicket (E6) closes the way to the Clearing: it burns the same way but grows back each time you come in, until Splashell is freed.
